articleTitle: Building the surf camp booking tool he wished he had
thumbnailAlt: José Paralta, founder of Hightide, featured in a Surfpreneurs Club interview

about.heading: The story behind Hightide
about.copy: Surfpreneurs spoke with Hightide’s founder about the experience of running surf camps, the booking problems that inspired the platform and why Hightide was built for businesses that combine accommodation, activities and packages.
